cards.name: brown brush strokes
cards.id: Draw/CustomMediaStrokes/Brush Strokes/brown brush strokes.cdr#brown brush strokes
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Sprayer list (Brush Strokes category). Shipped embedded preview of the sprayer list file (not a script render): Four diagonal dry-brush swipes in crimson rose, dusty mauve, rust brown and peach tan; each has a dense, paint-loaded rounded head at the upper right that fades into translucent streaky bristle tails at the lower left. Warm, soft gouache feel; the range is rose-to-brown rather than one brown.
use_for: makeup and foundation swatch motifs on beauty flyers
hand-painted accents along a path on cafe or craft posters
avoid: Dark or busy backgrounds: the translucent tails fade out; keep it on white or a light tint.
A single continuous brush line: the sprayer drops separate swipes along the path, not one stroke; use an Artistic Media Brush stroke (Artistic category) for a continuous line.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: the sprayer list's objects are repeated along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool in Sprayer mode, or select an existing curve and pick the list)
cards.how_to_apply: Artistic Media tool > Sprayer on the property bar > Category 'Brush Strokes' > Sprayer list 'brown brush strokes'; drag to draw, or select an existing curve and pick the list to apply it. Tune spray-object size, spray order, dabs and spacing, rotation and offset on the property bar; Object > Break Artistic Media Apart turns the result into editable objects. Script: no verified object-model call applies a sprayer list; fallback is Layer.Import of the file (C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Brush Strokes\brown brush strokes.cdr) to get its artwork, then placing copies along the path in code.

verified.note: Four diagonal dry-brush swipes in crimson rose, dusty mauve, rust brown and peach, loaded heads upper right fading to streaky tails, as described.
